column1: # Written by hand for the benchmark; NOT derived from ngrams_*.json or
# dictionaries/*-50k.txt, so the detector is not scored on the lists it loads.
# Some everyday words are of course also in the shipped vocabularies; the
# benchmark reports in-vocabulary and out-of-vocabulary words separately.
#   layout = the layout the word is meant to be typed in (ru or us).
#   * word categories (ru_*/en_*): measured both ways -- typed correctly (must
#     not change) and typed on the other layout (should be fixed).
#   * keep_* categories: typed as written on ``layout``; only checked for false
